_doc: Painted-puppet cast (original characters). kit = poses/p2/<kit>-<pose>. metres = standing height (top of head). Voices: Edge TTS (hi-IN has one male + one female neural voice; characters differ by pitch/rate). Bholu never speaks.

cast.name: Kabir
cast.role: curious 14-year-old mystery solver with glasses, teal jacket and satchel; calm, explains with evidence

cast.name: Bittu
cast.role: Kabir's chubby, funny best friend in an orange kurta; easily scared, food jokes, silly guesses

cast.name: Chiku
cast.role: Kabir's little cousin (8) in a red T-shirt with a magnifying glass; asks 'kyun?' about everything

cast.name: Anaya Didi
cast.role: Kabir's college-going elder sister; science student, sharp and witty, gives the real facts

cast.name: Meera Maa
cast.role: Kabir's warm, practical mother in a green salwar suit; worries, then laughs

cast.name: Ramesh Papa
cast.role: Kabir's father with glasses and a moustache, blue shirt; office-going, dad jokes, sceptical

cast.name: Kamla Dadi
cast.role: grandmother in a purple saree with round glasses and a walking stick; loves old stories and legends

cast.name: Hariprasad Dadaji
cast.role: grandfather with white hair, square glasses and a white moustache, grey cardigan; retired history teacher

cast.name: Bholu
cast.role: the family's brown-and-white dog with a red collar; never speaks, reacts (tilts head, wags, sits)
